summary: Victim lost 240 USD after being recruited through Reddit and Discord into a fake AI task platform that required an upfront deposit to access paid work. The operation used fake community members, fabricated payment proofs, and referral links to build trust before stealing deposits.
user_mistake: Paid an upfront deposit to join an online AI task platform
prevention: Never pay upfront fees for jobs or task platforms / Verify employers and platforms through independent sources before sending money
